message: The other day, I was rummaging through my pantry and stumbled upon a stash of canned goods that could feed a small army. I chuckled, thinking about how I always prepare for every storm like it’s going to be the next big blockbuster. My kids tease me about being 'gloriously over-prepared,' but hey, I’d rather have too many cans of soup than not enough! Just a little reminder that a cozy home and a few extra supplies can turn any weather hiccup into an indoor picnic instead. What’s your go-to comfort food for stormy days? ☔️
